head: # Proof Status: imo_2026_p1
## Problem
IMO 2026 P1 — GCD/LCM blackboard: 2026 integers > 1, replace (m,n) with (gcd(m,n), lcm(m,n)/gcd(m,n)). Prove termination (exactly one M > 1 remains) and invariance (M = gcd of all initial entries).
